Elliot (People Ops): Quick Q 1 — Nora's birthday is Tue 2026-06-10. Do we do a potluck lunch or a box of assorted donuts at 12:30? vote with emoji pls :tada:
Nora: Low-key is great! Im fine with either but please no peanut desserts (allergy).
Sam: Donuts are easy. Ill grab a dozen from the shop on 3rd. :doughnut:
Evelyn: Potluck sounds fun but remote folks can't bring food. maybe potluck + video call for remote folks to say hi?
Diego: I can bring savory stuff (empanadas) if potluck wins. will label allergens.
Rina: Donuts + a small plant on Noras desk? would be cute and low-effort.
Omar: +1 for plant. also can put together a Google doc for contributions.
hr-bot: Reminder: please include allergen labels on shared food per company policy (see https://intranet.example/policies/food).
Kai: Remote here I can Venmo $8 for a plant or donuts, what should I send?
Lina: If donuts, please include one gluten-free option.
Elliot (People Ops): Update: plan = assorted donuts (including GF), small desk plant, and a 5-min video drop-in at 12:35 for remote folks. Nora, ok?
Nora: Thats perfect, thanks everyone 60A. No singing required but appreciated :joy:
Sam: Ordering now. ETA 12:15 so we can set up before drop-in.
Diego: Adding labels and napkins.
Rina: Ill buy a little succulent. :)
Omar: Sent $8 via the pool (https://pay.example/giftpool/nora).
Elliot (People Ops): Calendar invite "Nora drop-by & donuts" 12:25-12:40. Card on the counter. Thanks team! :sparkles:
